name: Murder Mystery 3
seoDescription: Discover how to redeem Murder Mystery 3 codes for unique knives, swords, pets, and guns that add style and variety to your gameplay and collection.
introMd: Murder Mystery 3 is a game where players take on roles like Sheriff or Killer, trying to outsmart each other. Codes in the game unlock cool weapon skins and pets that you can use to stand out. These codes give you unique knives, swords, and other items that you won’t find just by playing. Knowing the right codes and how to use them can add a fresh twist to your matches and collection. Here’s a clear guide to help you get those rewards with Murder Mystery 3 codes.
redeemMd:
## How to Redeem Murder Mystery 3 Codes
There are no special requirements to redeem codes in Murder Mystery 3. Just follow these simple steps to claim your rewards.
1. Launch the game by clicking [[roblox_link|Launch Murder Mystery 3]].
2. Look for the blue Twitter icon on the side menu of the screen.
3. Click the icon to open the code entry box.
4. Type or paste an active code exactly as shown.
5. Press enter on your keyboard to redeem the reward.
6. Check your inventory to see the new item added.
rewardsMd:
## What Rewards You Normally Get?
Redeeming codes in Murder Mystery 3 usually grants you special weapon skins and pets that are unique to the game. These rewards often include knives, swords, and other themed items that change your in-game appearance.

| Reward Type       | Description                                   |
|-------------------|-----------------------------------------------|
| Knives            | Various unique knives with special designs, like the Candy Cane Lollipop or Soul Keeper Knife. |
| Swords            | Special swords such as the Chroma Slayer Sword or Galaxy Saber that stand out in battles. |
| Pets              | Cute or themed pets like Tentacles Jr. or Hidden Sparkletime that follow you in-game. |
| Guns              | Unique revolvers and guns like the Fortune Gun or Booster Luger. |

These items don’t affect gameplay mechanics but add style and variety to your character’s look.
troubleshootMd:
## Why Codes Might Not Work
Sometimes codes stop working because the game’s content is temporarily offline or deleted, as happened recently with Murder Mystery 3. If the game is under review or appeal, codes won’t redeem. Always check if the game is live before trying codes. Also, make sure you type codes exactly as shown, including capitalization and special characters.
findCodesMd:
